Klasse Node

java.lang.Object
feu.agenten.shogo_seifert.Node
public class Node extends Object
Represents a single node on the RINGWars game board. A Node acts as a lightweight container for one ring position.

A Node instance stores the index on the ring, the number of Fernie placed on it, and the owner.

It also provides lightweight helper methods.

  • Konstruktordetails

    • Node

      public Node(int index, int countsFernies, String owner)
      Creates a new Node instance with the specified index, number of placed Fernies and owner.
      Parameter:
      index - the index of the node on the ring
      countsFernies - the number of Fernies on the node
      owner - the owner of the node (also invisible and neutral)
